reviewed_invariants: Lua category order maps to SDK constants 0..=5
lconv decimal_point is its first pointer field
_lock_locales eagerly initializes locale APIs, then enters the CRT locale critical section
The Windows critical section is recursive; setlocale uses this same locale lock
Returned setlocale/lconv storage is copied while holding that lock
ctype inputs are restricted to unsigned bytes 0..=255
No Lua values or VM pointers cross the ABI
limitations: Verified Windows/MSVC declarations only. Miri cannot execute these Windows CRT calls. Other native-locale platforms, external CRT locale changes and host per-thread locale modes are not covered.
